December 7

18 Flee fornication. Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body. 19 What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? 20 For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's. (1 Corinthians 6:18-20 KJV)

God tells us to flee fornication, and we should flee from, and stay away from all sin, but the sin of fornication is different in that it defiles our bodies, which are the temple of the Lord, making this sin very grievous. We should always remember that our bodies are now the dwelling place of our Lord, and we should treat our bodies as fitting the temple of the Lord. This verse is pointing out that our bodies are not really our own, once we have been saved, as we have been bought with a price, the death of our Savior Jesus. Our bodies are a purchased possession, and will be changed into our new incorruptible bodies when Jesus comes again (1 Corinthians 15:51). Until then, we need to treat our bodies as the Holy Temple of the Lord, as that is what they are. Do not do anything with your body, that you would not do to the physical Temple of God, as we should act holy, and be holy, as God is Holy (1 Peter 1:16) and lives within us. Wow!

We Christians, need to always keep our bodies and souls clean and free from defilement of any kind, as we are the temple of God, and need to reflect that in our bodies, souls and spirits. If we would keep in mind how much God loves us, then we would always want to give His house a good cleaning and walk in a way that would glorify Him. Let us shine our light in this dark world (Matthew 5:16), and let people see Christ living in us and through us, to the degree that will cause Him to be glorified in everything we say and do. Walk in the light (1 John 1:7) - let your light shine. Always keep in mind who you have inside you, (Jesus), and you will want to live holy, as He is holy. If you keep your mind on the Word of God, and keep the Word in your heart, you will not have trouble letting Christ live through you. It is when we let our minds and actions become carnal, that we cease to live our lives for Him, and let Him live through us. Thank you Lord for letting me be Your Temple!
